summary: Add intentionally unwired typed native OMP process-proof and paired-person attachment admission APIs.

replay.detail: Native attach preparation, ask binding and externally owned channel-pending incarnation records persist as claims with audit predecessors. Existing claim storage retains their fields; no event replay is required.

schema.detail: Add disposable native attach claim lookup indexes on store open. No client schema or code generation changes.

rules.detail: Native attachment requires a one-shot expiring kernel-bound process report and an exact accepting assigned-person answer from a trusted live paired device with control.work. Generic claim writes cannot forge native attach authority. Commit atomically reserves the agent, process, native ID and answer.

compatibility.detail: The typed APIs remain unwired. Extension transport, CLI, channel readiness and dispatch arrive separately; automatic external-session rebinding must be refused before dispatch is connected. No running native sessions are attached by this change.

downtime.detail: No process restart or live-session interruption is performed.

manual.detail: No operator action is required for these intentionally unwired APIs. Restart consent is separate from attachment approval.

recovery.detail: Identical commits recover their persisted result. Expired or changed evidence, replayed approval and conflicting reservations fail closed. External incarnations convey no launch, kill, restart or startup-message authority.
